_README.how_to_use: Fill in exam_id, add shared passages/images to contexts[], add every question to questions[]. Delete this _README block and every _comment field before uploading. Remove any example question types you do not need.
hard_rules: exam_id must be an existing exam. section_id and topic_id must belong to that exam (see GET /api/catalog/exams/{id}).
Every question needs EXACTLY 4 options with option_no = 1,2,3,4.
Single-answer: set correct_option (1-4), leave is_multi_select=false, omit correct_options.
Multi-select: set is_multi_select=true and correct_options=[...] (values 1-4, no duplicates); omit correct_option.
Cancelled question: is_cancelled=true, cancelled_reason set, and NO correct_option / correct_options.
context_ref is a 0-based index into the top-level contexts[] array (null = standalone question).
Valid question_type values: text, text_image, image_only, context_text, context_image, marathi_only, bilingual.
marks defaults to 2, difficulty defaults to "medium" (easy|medium|hard), tags defaults to [].

per_type_field_requirements.text: text_en required. All 4 options need text_en.
per_type_field_requirements.text_image: text_en OR text_mr required, question_image_url required. Options need text in whichever language(s) the stem uses.
per_type_field_requirements.image_only: text_en AND text_mr must be null. question_image_url OR context_ref required. All 4 options need image_url.
per_type_field_requirements.context_text: context_ref required, text_en OR text_mr required. All 4 options need text_en.
per_type_field_requirements.context_image: context_ref required. All 4 options need image_url.
per_type_field_requirements.marathi_only: text_mr required, text_en must be null. All 4 options need text_mr.
per_type_field_requirements.bilingual: text_en AND text_mr required. All 4 options need text_en.

contexts._comment: Index 0 — a reading passage shared by several context_text questions.
contexts.content_en: It rained heavily all afternoon. The children stayed indoors and read books...
contexts.instruction_en: Read the passage and answer questions 5 and 6.

contexts._comment: Index 1 — a figure shared by context_image (Intelligence Test) questions.
contexts.instruction_en: Q7-8: Choose the figure that completes the series.

questions._comment: TYPE 1 — text: plain question, plain text options.
TYPE 2 — text_image: text stem + a figure in the question body.
questions.text_en: What fraction of the circle is shaded?

questions._comment: TYPE 3 — image_only: the image IS the question; text_en/text_mr MUST be null; every option is an image.
TYPE 4 — context_text: belongs to contexts[0]; text options.
questions.text_en: Where did the children stay during the rain?

questions._comment: TYPE 5 — context_image: belongs to contexts[1]; image options.
TYPE 6 — marathi_only: Marathi stem, text_en MUST be null; options in Marathi.
TYPE 7 — bilingual: EN + MR shown side by side; options carry both languages.
questions.text_en: How many sides does a triangle have?

questions._comment: MULTI-SELECT example — is_multi_select=true, correct_options set, no correct_option.
questions.text_en: Which of the following are prime numbers? (Select all that apply)

questions._comment: CANCELLED example — is_cancelled=true, cancelled_reason set, NO correct_option/correct_options. Options still required (4).
questions.text_en: This question was cancelled in the official answer key.
